other_list:
Exchange symmetry of the axial diquark coupling b^q_VR (§1.13): the reconstruction claims the symmetric flavour part survives, but the paper's text requires the antisymmetric part.
Scope of the "+ h.c." in Eq. (1) (§1.7, §1.8): the reconstruction excludes the phi and V flavour-changing terms from the h.c., while the paper's single "+ h.c." can be read as covering the whole equation, a reading that would change those cross sections by about a factor of four.
note: The reviewer's overall assessment would send a physicist to the right place: it confirms every interaction term maps correctly while clearly flagging the two substantive open points (the axial diquark exchange-symmetry error and the h.c. scope ambiguity) that need real checking.
